definition: one trip counted once if any of five categories has a healthy alternative
prediction: posterior-weighted fitted probability; incidence integrated over each observed trip food_spend
simulation: exact conditional expectations; no random draws and no model refitting
matching: main spending-DID pairs frozen; same IDs, cohorts, reuse and weights for both rate outcomes
inference: observed curve: fixed-match household-clustered CIs; model curve: fitted point predictions
conditional_model_standard_errors: CSV only; hold fitted parameters and smoothed posteriors fixed
interpretation: within-sample fit comparison on observed histories, not an event/no-event counterfactual
